description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'reqMgrSystemInterface' which serves as a base class for connecting to requirement management system interfaces. It contains properties and methods for managing configuration (XML), establishing connections, and retrieving project, baseline, and requirement data, intended to be extended by subclasses for specific system integrations.

classes.name: reqMgrSystemInterface
classes.description: An abstract base class providing the structure for connecting and interacting with requirement management systems. It supports XML configuration, connection management, and retrieval of projects, baselines, and requirements, meant to be extended for specific implementations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the object and initializes configuration and connection.

methods.name: setCfg
methods.description: Sets the configuration from an XML string and loads it into a SimpleXML object.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the interface information from the configuration.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection (meant to be overridden in subclasses).

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves available projects from the system.

methods.name: getBaselines
methods.description: Retrieves baselines for a specified project.

methods.name: getRequirements
methods.description: Retrieves requirements for a given project and baseline.
